speaker: alice
text: First up in the green corner, it is peak whale season up in Hervey Bay and honestly it sounds like an absolute spectacle. Humpback mums are pulling into those calm waters with their brand new calves to rest up before the long swim back to Antarctica.

speaker: charlie
text: Hervey Bay is one of the only spots in the world where whales actually stop for a break rather than just cruising past, and this year the numbers are looking strong, which is a ripper sign for the population bouncing back after decades of protection.

speaker: alice
text: And sticking with the ocean theme, the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority has kicked off its spring monitoring season with some genuinely encouraging coral growth on several reef sites. It is not all smooth sailing out there but every bit of good news for our reef is worth a cheer.
